summary: Step 1 UX overhaul verified end-to-end via browser automation on the preview URL. Guest login → dashboard-new-input+submit → /project/{id}/flow lands on Step 1 with the new UX: kicker copy ('Turn a messy client brief…'), 'under a minute' pill (step1-timepill), all 3 new labels ('What are you building?', 'Who is the client (and who are you actually talking to)?', 'What feels unclear or off?'), and all 3 helper testids (step1-what-helper, step1-who-helper, step1-unclear-helper) render. Auto-focus verified — document.activeElement === step1-what-input ~500ms after mount. Submit (step1-submit-btn) stays disabled when empty AND for 'asdf' gibberish, and step1-what-warning surfaces with the inline step1-inline-sample-btn link. step1-try-sample-btn CTA visible below the form. Clicking Try Sample: pre-fills all 3 textareas with realistic content (what=151 chars, who=130, unclear=215), step1-progress card renders with all 3 rows (detecting/scanning/framing) + estimate ~8/~6/~3 (requirements/clarifications/risks). After ~4-8s the AI returns and step1-framing-output renders (2579 chars), step1-sample-banner shows above and step1-sample-done-banner + step1-analyze-own-btn show below. Clicking Start yours routes back to /app. Auto-save: typing then waiting 700ms writes bracket:step1-draft:<projectId> to localStorage with correct JSON shape, and step1-draft-saved pill briefly appears. Regression on a fresh project confirms legacy Field wrapper testids (step1-what, step1-who, step1-unclear) still resolve.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectFlow.jsx line 1506-1518: Field renders helper inside

ProjectFlow.jsx line 384-397: The autosave useEffect returns a cleanup function from *inside* setTimeout's callback — the outer effect's return only clears the outer timeout, so setDraftSaved(false) is scheduled via a nested setTimeout whose cleanup is never re-registered. Works in practice (the nested timer fires 1.4s later) but it's a code-smell / potential React state-after-unmount warning. Prefer a top-level useEffect ref-guard or a single timeout that both flips setDraftSaved(true) then schedules the flip-back.

ProjectFlow.jsx line 1885: AISuggestions returns null when value < 2 chars OR no items — this means step1-what-suggest testid is intentionally absent until the user types. That's fine, but the review-request wording ('step1-what-suggest AI chips still resolve') should be read as 'render on demand', not 'always in DOM'. Not a bug.

ProjectFlow.jsx line 429-436 (trySample): pickSample() is called *inside* trySample so a user can get the same sample twice in a row on unlucky rolls. Trivial — but easy fix: track lastSampleKey in a ref and re-roll if it matches.
